goal: Survive the first winter. Start with `--season autumn` (a fresh world otherwise reaches winter only after about 57 minutes of game time). Note how food and cold feel.

findings.title: Game runs at 3-11 tps / 1-2 fps, so 'survive the first winter' is unreachable in a session even with --season autumn
findings.detail: Under parallel-session load (host load avg ~95 on 20 cores) the world ran at 3-11 ticks/s (50 is full speed) and 1-2 fps. The HUD said 'Winter in 2 days' at start (about 20 game minutes, ~60000 ticks). In ~25 wall minutes only ~8600 ticks (~3 game minutes) passed, so winter never arrived and food/cold could not be tested. Expected: either faster sim under load or a shorter autumn when starting with --season autumn (e.g. start late in autumn) so a playtest can reach winter.
findings.repro: pt start --profile beyond-nations --game-dir /root/bn-wt-playtest064 --seed 103 --season autumn; pt key space; pt click 480 315; pt click 480 315; pt status (tps); play 25 min; pt state (season still Autumn)

findings.title: Objective 6 progress bar shows Wood 20/20 Stone 5/5 after the Farm spent the materials
findings.detail: Right after building a Farm (25 wood, 10 stone) inside my settlement, Objective 6 'Build a market stall' showed a full gold bar 'Wood 20/20 • Stone 5/5' while inventory was Wood 5, Stone 0. Expected 5/20 and 0/5. The objective text also runs under the Inventory panel.
findings.repro: pt start --profile beyond-nations --game-dir /root/bn-wt-playtest064 --seed 103 --season autumn; pt key space; pt click 480 315; pt click 480 315; gather 55 wood+5 stone; pt key n; walk off claimed land; pt key f; gather 25 wood+10 stone; pt key h; pt key e; pt key k; pt key k

findings.title: Winter countdown stays at 'Winter in 2 days' and day numbers disagree across HUD
findings.detail: Season panel read 'Autumn - day 1/2, year 1 / Winter in 2 days' from timeOfDay 0.30 to 0.59 without changing. The chronicle labels the same time 'Day 5', state.json says day 4. For a goal about preparing for winter, the player cannot tell how long they have. Expected a countdown that decreases (e.g. '1.5 days', or hours) and one consistent day number.
findings.repro: pt start --profile beyond-nations --game-dir /root/bn-wt-playtest064 --seed 103 --season autumn; pt key space; pt click 480 315; pt click 480 315; watch Season panel for several game minutes

findings.title: Found-settlement refusal gives a compass direction but the HUD has no compass or map
findings.detail: Pressing F on claimed land says 'Open ground lies about 200 to the north-west' (later 'north', then 'about 10 to the north-west' near another town's 250 m radius). Nothing on screen shows which way north is; I had to walk test legs and watch the distance change. Took ~4300 ticks to find valid ground. Expected a compass strip, a map, or an arrow/marker pointing at open ground.
findings.repro: pt start --profile beyond-nations --game-dir /root/bn-wt-playtest064 --seed 103 --season autumn; pt key space; pt click 480 315; pt click 480 315; chop 10 trees; pt key n; reach 50 wood near (108,270); pt key f

findings.title: Build confirm (K twice) times out at low frame rates
findings.detail: Pressing K then K again ~8 s wall later (~40 ticks) gave 'Not confirmed in time, so nothing was done.' twice; only a ~1 s double-tap worked. B (stall) builds with no confirmation at all, which is inconsistent. Expected a visible confirm prompt/button or a longer window.
findings.repro: pt start --profile beyond-nations --game-dir /root/bn-wt-playtest064 --seed 103 --season autumn; pt key space; pt click 480 315; pt click 480 315; inside own settlement with 25 wood 10 stone: pt key k; pt wait 8; pt key k

findings.title: Settlement HUD reflows: Inventory panel jumps mid-screen, objective bar text clipped, Season overlaps Player Info
findings.detail: With a resident nearby inside the settlement, the Inventory Info panel moved to the middle of the screen over the world, the Objective 7 bar read 'nbers 2/10 • Buildings 1/2' (left clipped), and the Season panel overlapped the Player Info header. Irene Taylor, who had joined my nation, was offered as 'Talk to Irene Taylor (Stranger)'. The large floating '1 here, 2/8 residents' label also sits behind the chronicle.
findings.repro: pt start --profile beyond-nations --game-dir /root/bn-wt-playtest064 --seed 103 --season autumn; pt key space; pt click 480 315; pt click 480 315; found a settlement; build Farm and Stall; stand at the well while a member is near

verdict: Winter never arrived: at ~6 tps only ~3 game minutes passed in 25 wall minutes, so food and cold were not tested. Food looked like no worry before winter, since every tree gives 1-3 apples and I had 28 apples with energy at 91-98. The early loop (chop, nation, settle, farm, stall) reads well and the objectives guide it, but the 'north-west' hint with no compass and an objective bar that showed full when it was not were the main stumbles.
